plugins.name: littlejs
plugins.description: Make games and graphics-heavy apps with LittleJS, a fast open-source HTML5 engine. Ask for a game and get a complete playable project in seconds - 2D, Box2D physics, or three.js 3D - that runs by opening a file, with nothing to install. Keeps your code idiomatic as the project grows.
